notes.title: GUI/Progress Hotfix
notes.notes:
[list]
[*]Fixed an issue where powerup effects did not play correctly on some machines.
[*]Fixed an issue where progress could be halted after defeating bosses on some machines.
[/list]

notes.title: Health Bar Hotfix
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug introduced in the last update which could cause the visuals on the Health & Shield Bars to stop being updated correctly.
[/list]

notes.title: Achievement Viewer & Accessibility/Colorblind Update
notes.notes:
[h1]Achievement Viewer[/h1]
[list]
[*] A new menu added to the help screen in the Main Menu & Pause Menu.
[*] View all of the locked/unlocked achievements along.
[*] Names, descriptions and images of all achievements provided.
[*] Percentage of players who achieved each is also provided.
[/list]


[h1]Colorblind Options[/h1]
[list]
[*] None -Enabled by Default
[*] Protanopia - Simulates missing red cones.
[*] Protanomaly - Simulates reduced sensitivity red cones.
[*] Deuteranopia - Simulates missing green cones.
[*] Deuteranomaly - Simulates reduced sensitivity green cones.
[*] Tritanopia - Simulates missing blue cones.
[*] Tritanomaly - Simulates reduced sensitivity blue cones.
[*] Achromatopsia - Simulates completely missing cones.
[*] Achromatomaly - Simulates reduced sensitivity of all cones
[/list]


Please note that this only impacts the gameplay camera and not the U.I.


Cheers!

notes.title: 2022-08-25 Patch
notes.notes:
[h1]Patch Notes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug which caused music not to play on the cutscenes before and after the Magical Meadows stage.
[/list]

notes.title: Rebranding Update
notes.notes: The game has been renamed from Nectar to Nectar Wars. Artwork in the game has been modified to reflect this change.

notes.title: Player Feedback Patch #3
notes.notes:
[h1]Patch Notes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Invincibility time increased to 3 seconds from 1.75 upon respawn.
[*] All birds & butterflies have been rebalanced to fire faster but each bullet deals less damage, overall damage output is the same.
[*] Dying now results in losing 1 upgrade level rather than reverting back to 1.
[*] Diagonal movement speed is now normalized.
[*] Enemies now despawn sooner upon exiting the screen.
[*] Fire Demons & Bats have had their projectile hitboxes rescaled.
[*] Crystal's level 2 firing angle reduced.
[/list]

notes.title: Player Feedback Patch #2 - Overworld Adjustments
notes.notes:
[h1]Overworld Modifications[/h1]
[list]
[*] The cosmetic's name is now displayed on the Customization Screen.
[*] The boundaries of entering a level has been moved up and widened.
[*] Fixed a bug on the customization screen where audio would not play.
[*] Fixed a bug when using the gamepad and closing the customization screen which caused it to re-open.
[*] Fixed a bug related to Flight Cadet/Easy Difficulty.
[/list]

notes.title: Player Feedback Patch
notes.notes:
[b]Easy Difficulty/Flight Cadet[/b]
[list]
[*] Adjustments made to make this mode slightly easier.
[*] Fixed a bug in the overworld isolated to this difficulty level.
[/list]


[b]Spike[/b]
[list]
[*] Projectiles are now more visible.
[*] Fires less often & Missiles survive for less time.
[/list]
